transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um, hi. I guess I'm just... having a hard time getting organized. Between my schoolwork and this little accessories shop I have, I just can't seem to keep it all straight at the same time. My supplies, the due dates, receipts, assignment notes... they just all end up in these piles. I don't really know what to do first anymore.
Do you often find yourself struggling to focus on a single task, like your schoolwork or managing the shop, for a long period of time?

Yeah, I guess so. Um... like in class, or if I'm watching a video for my business assignments. I'll start out listening, but... after a few minutes, my mind just kind of drifts to new charm designs or... ideas for orders. And then I realize I missed half of what was said. So, yeah.
Are these difficulties with organization and focus causing you a lot of stress or problems in your daily life?

Yeah... I guess so. Um... it's just... I actually missed some required steps for my program recently, so... my financial aid is kind of at risk right now. And... I don't know, the people I usually work with on shop projects... they've started depending on me a lot less. So... yeah. It's causing problems.
Have you always had trouble with organization and focus, even when you were a kid?

Um... yeah, I guess. My mom actually still has some of my old elementary school notes. They usually said I was... always out of my seat, or talking before they called on me. And that I'd rush through group activities, even when I already understood the work. So... yeah.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety when you're sitting still?

Um... yeah, I guess. Like... if I have to sit through a lecture, or... a study group meeting or something. I don't really notice I'm doing it at first, but... my leg is usually bouncing. Or I'll be clicking a pen... or just messing with the beads and key rings in my bag. It just sort of happens. So... yeah.
Did you have trouble sitting still or paying attention in class when you were little?
Um... I mean, I think I just mentioned that. My mom's old notes from elementary school said I couldn't stay in my seat and talked out of turn a lot. So... yeah, I guess I did.
Are your difficulties with organization and focus affecting your relationships with friends or family?

Um... I don't really know about my family. But... I guess it affects other people. Like... the people I work with on shop projects have kind of started depending on me less. And... because of all this, I missed some required steps for my program. So now my financial aid is at risk. So... yeah. I guess it causes issues.
Have you experienced difficulties with organization and focus for as long as you can remember?

Um... not exactly. I mean... the really bad parts, like with the focus and everything... it's been more like... two years? And maybe a couple of months. It got a lot worse when I changed schools. I started a business program and... I have this accessories shop I run. It's just... a lot less structure now. So... yeah, that's when it became a real problem.
Have you ever experienced any significant periods where your symptoms of disorganization and inattention were completely absent?
Um... I'm not really sure. I don't think so? I mean... I haven't really kept track of it like that. It's just kind of... always been a thing, I guess.
Do you experience these difficulties with organization and focus at home, in the shop, and in school, or are they mostly in one of these places?
Um... I guess everywhere? I don't really know... it's just kind of a problem no matter where I am.
Do you find that your difficulties with organization and focus happen consistently, regardless of the situation or environment you're in?
Um... I guess so? I don't really pay attention to... the exact situations or anything. It just... happens, I guess. I haven't really thought about it.
Are there any situations where you feel your organization and focus are significantly better than in others?
No... not really. I don't think there's anywhere that it's... better. It's pretty much just the same no matter what I'm doing.
Are there any specific activities or tasks where you feel more in control and focused than others?
Um... I don't know. I can't really think of anything right now. I just... do things, I guess. I haven't really noticed feeling any different with specific stuff.
Have you experienced any other mental health issues, such as depression or anxiety, alongside your difficulties with organization and focus?
Um... no. I don't think so. I haven't really... felt like that, I guess. Just... the stuff we already talked about.
Have you ever had any physical complaints, such as headaches or stomachaches, when you have to sit still or focus for a long time?
Um... no. Not really. I don't get sick or anything like that. I just... get antsy, I guess. But no headaches or anything.
Have your difficulties with organization and focus been present for at least 6 months?

Um... yeah. Longer than that. I think... maybe like two years and a couple of months? It just... became a real problem when I changed schools. I was trying to manage my business program and... this accessories shop I have. There was just less structure, I guess. So... yeah. A while.
Have your difficulties with organization and focus been present in two or more settings, such as at home, in school, or in the shop?
Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't really... paid attention to where I am when it happens, I guess. I just kind of feel that way in general, so... I don't really know.
Do you often act impulsively, doing things without thinking them through?
Um... I don't really know. I haven't really thought about it like that. I just... do things, I guess. I wouldn't say I'm impulsive or anything.
Did you often interrupt others or blurt out answers when you were a kid?

Um... yeah. I guess so. My mom... she actually still has these old notes from my elementary school teachers. They said I was... always out of my seat. And, um... talking before I was called on. They also said I'd rush through group activities, even if I already understood the work. So... yeah. I guess I did that.
Do you often have difficulty with impulsivity, such as interrupting others or acting without thinking?

Um... yeah, I guess. Like... if we're doing group critiques or talking in class, I... I just kind of jump in. Before they're even done talking. And then... I don't know, I just feel really stupid after, because I usually just guessed what they were trying to say anyway. So... yeah.
